verdict.rationale: Poly ships a built-in agent that can search, read, write, edit, and organize files across multiple steps (poly-docs-14, poly-docs-27, poly-docs-31), and can even spawn subagents to delegate subtasks (poly-docs-21, poly-docs-35), directly matching the story of delegating tasks to an in-product AI assistant. This is corroborated by runtime probes confirming a live agent/MCP infrastructure (poly-probe-rt-1, poly-probe-rt-2). Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports specifically validating the agent's task execution (community commentary focuses on search/security concerns rather than confirming agentic task delegation in practice).
